name: Xingyi, Guizhou
tagline: Dreamland of Karst Mountains & Healing Smiles
intro: The hometown of our founder and the heart of the Jingzhou Dental Group. Xingyi sits inside a sea of cone-shaped karst peaks — the Wanfenglin ('Forest of Ten Thousand Peaks') that astonished the explorer Xu Xiake. Cool air, slow living and astonishing scenery make it an ideal place to heal after treatment.

highlights.name: Wanfenglin (万峰林)
highlights.description: A 5A-rated landscape of thousands of green karst peaks, best seen by bike or hot-air balloon at sunrise.

highlights.name: Maling River Gorge (马岭河峡谷)
highlights.description: Called 'the most beautiful scar on Earth' — a canyon threaded with hundreds of waterfalls. Boardwalks bring you right to the mist.

highlights.name: Bouyei Ethnic Villages
highlights.description: Visit traditional Bouyei communities, try hand-dyed textiles and savour sour-soup fish by the river.

highlights.name: Hua Jiang Canyon Bridge (花江峡谷大桥)
highlights.description: One of the world's highest bridges — a jaw-dropping feat of engineering spanning a deep canyon, a new must-see near Xingyi.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Xingyi
itinerary.description: Transfer from Guiyang or Xingyi airport; relaxed evening.

itinerary.title: Consultation & Treatment
itinerary.description: Clinic visit and start of treatment; afternoon rest at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Wanfenglin Cycling
itinerary.description: Easy bike ride through the peak forest with photo stops.

itinerary.title: Maling Gorge Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Canyon walk among the falls — gentle and restorative.

itinerary.title: Hua Jiang Bridge & Departure
itinerary.description: See the bridge, final check-up, transfer out.

medical.advantages: Xingyi is where the Jingzhou Dental Group began. The clinic pairs provincial-leading equipment with the warmth of a community practice. Lower operating costs mean excellent value, while the serene surroundings support a calm recovery.
